title: Shared pool to paid overage
summary: Consume included AI credits first, then show how paid usage flows into metered budgets.

steps.title: Consume most included credits
steps.description: Alice consumes 5,000 of the 5,800 pooled credits.
steps.expected: No paid overage is created and 800 pooled credits remain.

steps.title: Exhaust the shared pool
steps.description: The remaining 800 included credits are consumed.
steps.expected: The pool reaches 100%, while metered cost remains $0.

steps.title: Create paid overage
steps.description: A further 1,000 credits can no longer use the pool.
steps.expected: $10 of paid overage is attributed to the cost-center and enterprise budgets.
